tools.name: get-video-summary
tools.title: Get Video Summary
tools.description: Fetches the transcript and metadata of a YouTube video so you can summarize it.
tools.instructions: Fetch a YouTube video transcript and metadata for summarization

url.description: The YouTube video URL or video ID to summarize

ai.instructions: You summarize YouTube videos. When the user provides a YouTube URL or video ID, use the get-video-summary tool to fetch the transcript and metadata. Format the summary as key highlights with emoji + headline + one sentence description. If the user asks follow-up questions about the video, answer based on the transcript you received from the tool.
